back: An explicit Deny always wins. Then an Allow is needed in EVERY applicable layer: SCP/RCP, permissions boundary, session policies, and identity- or resource-based policies.

es.back: Un Deny explícito siempre gana. Luego se necesita un Allow en TODAS las capas aplicables: SCP/RCP, permissions boundary, políticas de sesión, políticas de identidad o de recurso.

back: A managed policy that sets the maximum permissions a user or role can have; useful for delegating role creation.

es.back: Política administrada que fija el máximo de permisos que puede tener un usuario o rol; útil para delegar la creación de roles.

back: A role in the target account with a trust policy for the source account + sts:AssumeRole. For third parties, add sts:ExternalId (confused deputy).

es.back: Rol en la cuenta destino con trust policy hacia la cuenta origen + sts:AssumeRole. Para terceros, añadir sts:ExternalId (confused deputy).

front: Cognito user pools vs identity pools
back: User pools: user directory and authentication (JWT tokens). Identity pools: exchange identities for temporary AWS credentials.

es.front: Cognito user pools vs identity pools
es.back: User pools: directorio de usuarios y autenticación (tokens JWT). Identity pools: intercambian identidades por credenciales temporales de AWS.

back: Service control policies: limit the maximum permissions in accounts/OUs (they do not grant permissions). They do not affect the management account.

es.back: Service Control Policies: limitan el máximo de permisos en cuentas/OU (no otorgan permisos). No afectan a la cuenta de administración.

back: Restricts access to principals that belong to your AWS organization; ideal in bucket policies.

es.back: Restringe el acceso a principales que pertenecen a tu organización de AWS; ideal en políticas de bucket.

back: SSE-S3 (default), SSE-KMS (auditing and key control; use S3 Bucket Keys to reduce cost), DSSE-KMS (dual layer), SSE-C (customer key), and client-side encryption.

es.back: SSE-S3 (por defecto), SSE-KMS (auditoría y control de claves; usa S3 Bucket Keys para reducir costo), DSSE-KMS (doble capa), SSE-C (clave del cliente) y cifrado del lado cliente.

back: KMS generates a data key (GenerateDataKey); data is encrypted locally with it and the encrypted data key is stored. Direct KMS Encrypt: 4 KB maximum.

es.back: KMS genera una data key (GenerateDataKey); los datos se cifran localmente con ella y se guarda la data key cifrada. Encrypt directo de KMS: máximo 4 KB.

front: Encrypt an existing unencrypted RDS instance
back: Snapshot → copy the snapshot with encryption → restore a new instance → switch endpoints.

es.front: Cifrar una RDS existente sin cifrar
es.back: Snapshot → copiar snapshot con cifrado → restaurar nueva instancia → cambiar endpoints.

back: To copy encrypted snapshots to another Region, re-encrypt with a key in the destination Region, or use multi-Region keys.

es.back: Para copiar snapshots cifrados a otra región se re-cifra con una clave de destino, o se usan multi-Region keys.

back: GuardDuty (threats), Inspector (vulnerabilities), Macie (PII in S3), Detective (investigation), Security Hub (aggregator), Config (configuration compliance).

es.back: GuardDuty (amenazas), Inspector (vulnerabilidades), Macie (PII en S3), Detective (investigación), Security Hub (agregador), Config (cumplimiento de configuración).

front: WAF: where it can be associated
back: CloudFront, ALB, API Gateway, AppSync, Cognito user pools, and App Runner. It cannot be associated with an NLB.

es.back: CloudFront, ALB, API Gateway, AppSync, Cognito user pools y App Runner. No se asocia a NLB.

front: Network Firewall vs WAF vs SG/NACL
back: Network Firewall: stateful/IPS/domain filtering at the VPC level. WAF: layer 7 for web apps. SG/NACL: IP/port filtering.

es.front: Network Firewall vs WAF vs SG/NACL
es.back: Network Firewall: stateful/IPS/filtrado por dominio a nivel VPC. WAF: capa 7 para apps web. SG/NACL: filtrado por IP/puerto.

back: Gateway: only S3 and DynamoDB, free, through the route table. Interface (PrivateLink): ENI with a private IP, almost every service, charged per hour/GB.

es.back: Gateway: sólo S3 y DynamoDB, sin costo, vía tabla de rutas. Interface (PrivateLink): ENI con IP privada, casi todos los servicios, con costo por hora/GB.

back: A NAT gateway is redundant only within its AZ: create one per AZ and route each private subnet to its local NAT.

es.back: Un NAT gateway es redundante sólo en su AZ: crea uno por AZ y enruta cada subred privada a su NAT local.

back: Use a DENY rule in the NACL (security groups have no deny rules), or WAF for web traffic.

es.back: Usa una regla DENY en la NACL (los security groups no tienen reglas de denegar) o WAF si es tráfico web.

back: Exposes a service (behind an NLB/GWLB) to other VPCs/accounts through private interface endpoints, without peering or routes between VPCs.

es.back: Expone un servicio (detrás de NLB/GWLB) a otras VPC/cuentas mediante interface endpoints privados, sin peering ni rutas entre VPC.

back: Inbound: on-premises resolves AWS names. Outbound: the VPC forwards queries to on-premises DNS (forwarding rules).

es.back: Inbound: on-premises resuelve nombres de AWS. Outbound: la VPC reenvía consultas al DNS local (reglas de reenvío).

back: Origin Access Control (OAC) + a bucket policy that only allows the distribution. Signed URLs/cookies for paid content.

es.back: Origin Access Control (OAC) + política de bucket que sólo permita la distribución. URL/cookies firmadas para contenido de pago.

back: Governance: users with a special permission can bypass retention. Compliance: nobody, not even root, can delete or shorten retention.

es.back: Governance: usuarios con permiso especial pueden saltar la retención. Compliance: nadie, ni root, puede borrar ni acortar la retención.
